context: Sakura goes to the doctor by herself for the first time, for a minor cold. Dr. Saito treats her seriously like a young adult.
purpose: rite-of-passage moment — being treated as a grown patient for the first time

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: さくらさん、今日は一人で来たんですね。
lines.style: Doctor warm respectful recognition, the adult-treatment audible in the cadence, soft real care threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ちょっと風邪っぽくて。
lines.en: Yes, I think it might be a cold.
lines.style: Teen careful adult-attempting voice, the slight nervous self-management audible, soft real composure threading throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 熱はどうですか。咳もある？
lines.style: Doctor professional warm questioning, the standard sequence held respectfully, soft real attention threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Teen composed adult-clinical report, the careful precise answering, soft real maturity threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 大丈夫そうですね。お薬出しますね。
lines.en: You'll be alright. I'll prescribe some medicine.
lines.style: Doctor warm reassuring conclusion, the gentle professional clarity, soft real reassurance threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。安心しました。
lines.style: Teen warm grateful adult-closing, the relief audible underneath, soft real maturity threading throughout delivery throughout.
